decisions.rationale: The table is hourly weather per airport: origin has 3 distinct values (EWR, JFK, LGA) and time_hour has 4341 distinct hourly timestamps; 3 x 4341 = 13023, close to the 13014-row count, so (origin, time_hour) plausibly identifies one row; both are null_rate 0.0 and required.
duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 13014, so no exact duplicate rows exist in bronze and dedupe strategy is none.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata: true and are dropped as capture-tool columns, not business columns.

year, month, day, hour, and wind_dir landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but every profiled value is integral (e.g. month 1.0-6.0, hour 0.0-23.0, wind_dir multiples of 10 up to 360.0), so they are cast to INTEGER.
All time_hour samples are ISO-8601 UTC strings like 2013-01-01T06:00:00Z with null_rate 0.0, so the column is cast to TIMESTAMP.
wind_gust has null_rate 0.745505 (9702 of 13014 rows); the column is sparsely populated by nature (gusts occur intermittently) and is retained nullable without imputation.
wind_speed max is 1048.36058, which is physically implausible for an hourly wind speed; the value is retained as landed and flagged here for reviewer attention rather than filtered.

purpose: silver_nyc_weather provides cleaned hourly weather observations for the three New York City area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) during the first half of 2013, derived from the bronze nyc_weather landing table. It feeds flight-delay analysis and any downstream model joining weather conditions to operations at the origin-airport, hour grain.
usage: Read one row per (origin, time_hour), where time_hour is a proper TIMESTAMP in UTC. Join to flight data on origin and time_hour. Consumers must handle nulls deliberately: wind_gust is null on roughly 75% of rows (gusts are recorded only when they occur), pressure is null on about 11.5% of rows, and wind_dir and wind_speed carry a small number of nulls. Be aware that wind_speed contains at least one extreme value (max 1048.36058) retained from source.
limitations: Coverage is limited to 2013 months 1 through 6 (year has a single value 2013.0, month values 1.0-6.0). Nulls in wind_gust (74.55%), pressure (11.50%), wind_dir (1.68%), and wind_speed (0.02%) are retained without imputation. The implausible wind_speed maximum of 1048.36058 was not corrected or filtered, as the cleanup does not alter measured values. No clock-drift or duplicate handling was applied because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0.
